DAS 2 must require that purchases of fire fighting foam be made 3 from the seller whose product contains the greatest content 4 of soybean-based materials without containing perfluoroalkyl 5 or polyfluoroalkyl substances or fluorine components unless 6 such fire fighting foam is unavailable to meet a state 7 agency’s needs, does not meet the standards of the national 8 fire protection association, or costs more than 105 percent 9 of the cost of fire fighting foam that is not soybean-based 10 or contains perfluoroalkyl or polyfluoroalkyl substances or 11 fluorine components. 12 DAS must create a program for procuring the preferred fire 13 fighting foam and must share information about the preferences 14 for fire fighting foam products in publications used to solicit 15 bids, at bidders’ conferences, in procurement solicitations or 16 invitations to bid, and with industry trade associations. 17 DAS must provide that when purchasing fire fighting foam, 18 DAS or a state agency authorized by DAS to directly purchase 19 fire fighting foam shall give preference to purchasing biobased 20 fire fighting foam manufactured from soybeans.
